name: The One Page Pilot Record
title: The One Page Pilot Record
answer: The One Page Pilot Record is a single page that captures a pilot's problem, tool, teachers, main measure, baseline, result, decision, incidents, and cost. It matters because it preserves the district's own memory of what was tried and learned, so a board member, a new principal, or a later team can understand a tool choice without relying on a vendor's slide deck. It also lets a district compare pilots and reuse what worked.

sections.body: The idea is to require every pilot to leave behind one page that anyone can read in two minutes. The page names the problem, the tool, the teachers, the main measure, the baseline, the result, and the decision, and it also notes incidents and cost. This solves the problem of fading memory: staff change, vendors change their products, and people forget why a tool was chosen. It also prevents a vendor slide deck from becoming the default explanation for spending. Over time, the stack of records becomes the district's own evidence base.
sections.heading: The idea

sections.body: In practice, the record is created as part of the pilot and kept for later use. The text does not give grade bands, so the same one page format applies wherever a pilot runs. A district that has run five pilots can compare them side by side, see which measures were easy to collect, and reuse the family notice and exit criteria that worked. When a new principal arrives, the stack of pilot records tells them what the district has already tried and learned. A board member who asks why the district pays for a tool should be handed this page rather than a slide deck from the vendor.
sections.heading: How it works in school

sections.body: The text gives no evidence label, study, or finding for this idea. It refers to Figure 4.8 only to show the layout of the one page record. The text says that local evidence often matters more than any national study because it comes from the district's own students and teachers, but it does not cite a national study or present a research result. On the supplied text, this idea rests on practice rather than research.
sections.heading: What the evidence says

sections.body: The text sets no formal guardrails beyond the record itself. It warns that memories fade, staff change, and vendors change their products, so the page is what keeps the reason for a tool choice visible. It says the page must note incidents and cost and must name the decision. It does not say which person holds which decision, so that remains outside what the text sets out. The main limit is that the record only works if it is made, kept, and read.
